get.summary: Subject categories, subjects, education levels and teaching languages (mk/en names).
Leads, tests, page visits, offers, onboarding and the conversion funnel for the last 7, 30 or 90 days.
A published test with its questions and options (never the correct answers).

post.summary: Submit the chosen options; the server scores them and returns the totals and an attempt id for an optional contact request.
Create a draft test with its questions and options. 409 TEST_SLUG_TAKEN for a used address.

get.summary: The whole test including the correct options (teacher only).

put.summary: Replace the test (questions keep their ids). 409 on a stale version; 409 TEST_HAS_ATTEMPTS for destructive edits after attempts (D-38).

delete.summary: Archive: hidden from the list and the public; attempts and the address are kept.

post.summary: Publish after the checks: a question, two options and a correct answer each, points. 400 lists what is missing.
An editable draft copy with new ids and no attempts (D-38: "duplicate as new version").

get.summary: How often the test was taken, and the results visitors shared with their contact request.
Issue an antiforgery request token (also in the X-XSRF-TOKEN response header).

post.summary: Create a teacher account. Always answers 202 (no account enumeration).

patch.summary: Update the account's language and time zone.

get.summary: Contact form data of a published site: availability, a signed form token, offers, subjects and the consent text.

post.summary: Send a message or lesson request to the teacher. Always 202 without echoing data; spam is dropped silently.

get.summary: The inbox, newest first: filter by status, type, text (name, email, message) and archived.

put.summary: New → Contacted → Converted, close at any point, reopen a closed lead. 422 INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION; 409 stale version.

delete.summary: Archive the offer (hidden, never bookable again; history is kept).

get.summary: The site draft, or suggestions to start from when it does not exist yet (exists = false).

put.summary: Save the draft (slug, template, palette, language, sections). Visitors see the draft only after publishing.

post.summary: Publish the saved draft at /{slug}. 422 SITE_NOT_CREATED before the first save; 409 when the version is stale.
Take the public page offline (404). The draft is kept.
A signed preview URL for the current draft, valid for 15 minutes.

put.summary: Upload the profile photo (JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 5 MB, at least 128 × 128). Stored re-encoded as WebP without metadata.

get.summary: Onboarding checklist derived from the workspace's data (never ticked manually).
